newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle sales steady $64, light - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle sales steady $64, light - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry was good and demand moderate.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1275 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1150 lbs 64.00, pen 950 lbs 63.00.
Wk to date - 94,600 last week - 82,200 last year - 59,500

Sales confirmed on 1,500 slaughter steers and 1,900 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 94,600 head confirmed including 26,200 head or about 28 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
